_readme: Brand hub pages built by build.py from the ranked category data. Each page shows the brand's highest-ranked product in every category where it made our top 10, grouped by battery platform, and says honestly where another brand ranked higher. 'brand' must match the product 'brand' field exactly (case-insensitive). Set "enabled": false to drop a page. 'button' / 'button_text' are the brand's own color and the text color it pairs with, used on that brand's buttons.

brands.title: Best DEWALT Tools (2026): Our Top Pick in Every Category
brands.subtitle: Staying loyal to DEWALT yellow? Here's the highest-ranked DEWALT in each of our top-10 lists, and how it stacks up against the best from any brand.
brands.intro: Once you own a couple of DEWALT 20V MAX batteries, every new tool is cheaper as a bare tool on the same platform. So the useful question isn't "what's the best drill?" but "what's the best DEWALT drill?" Every pick below is the top-scoring DEWALT product in one of our ranked lists, scored on the same data as everything else on the site: Amazon star rating, number of reviews, and the features that matter for the job.

faq.q: Is DEWALT 20V MAX the same as 18V?
faq.a: Yes, in practice. "20V MAX" is the battery's peak voltage with no load; under load it runs at a nominal 18V, the same as other brands' 18V tools. The number is marketing, not extra power.

faq.q: Do DEWALT FLEXVOLT batteries work in 20V MAX tools?
faq.a: Yes. FLEXVOLT batteries switch voltage automatically and run 20V MAX tools. It doesn't work the other way: a 20V MAX battery won't power a 60V FLEXVOLT tool.

faq.q: What does XR mean on DEWALT tools?
faq.a: XR is DEWALT's premium 20V MAX line. XR tools are usually brushless, with more power and runtime than the standard 20V MAX versions. They cost more, and our scores show whether that premium pays off in each category.

faq.q: Should I buy a bare tool or a kit?
faq.a: If you already own DEWALT 20V MAX batteries and a charger, buy the bare tool ("tool only"). It's the same tool for much less money. If this is your first DEWALT cordless tool, buy a kit so you get a battery and charger in the box.

faq.q: Why isn't DEWALT listed in every category?
faq.a: We only show DEWALT tools that made our ranked top 10. Where no DEWALT made the cut, we link to that list so you can see the best from any brand.

brands.title: Best Milwaukee Tools (2026): Our Top Pick in Every Category
brands.subtitle: Committed to Milwaukee red? Here's the highest-ranked Milwaukee in each of our top-10 lists, from M18 FUEL power tools to PACKOUT storage.
brands.intro: Milwaukee owners tend to stay Milwaukee: one M18 battery runs a huge range of tools, and PACKOUT boxes only lock to other PACKOUT boxes. So this page answers one question: which Milwaukee is the best buy in each category? Every pick is the top-scoring Milwaukee product in one of our ranked lists, scored on the same data as everything else on the site: Amazon star rating, number of reviews, and the features that matter for the job.

faq.q: Do Milwaukee M12 and M18 batteries fit each other's tools?
faq.a: No. M12 and M18 are separate platforms with different battery shapes. M12 tools are smaller and lighter; M18 tools have more power. Most people pick one as their main platform and add the other only for compact jobs.

faq.q: What's the difference between M18 and M18 FUEL?
faq.a: M18 FUEL is Milwaukee's premium line, with brushless motors and more power and runtime than standard M18 tools. Both run on the same M18 batteries.

faq.q: Does PACKOUT work with other brands' tool boxes?
faq.a: No. PACKOUT pieces lock to each other, not to DEWALT TSTAK or ToughSystem or other brands' modular boxes. If you're already invested in PACKOUT, stay with it; if you're starting fresh, compare it against the other systems on our tool box lists.

faq.q: Why is there no Milwaukee drill on this page?
faq.a: Our lists are built from Amazon's best-selling, most-reviewed products, and no Milwaukee drill made our cordless drill top 10 when we last checked. See our cordless drill list for the best from any brand.

faq.q: Should I buy a bare tool or a kit?
faq.a: Nearly all the Milwaukee power tools here are bare tools ("tool only"), which is how Milwaukee sells best on Amazon. They make sense if you already own M18 or M12 batteries and a charger. If you don't, add a starter battery kit, or pick a kit from our main lists instead.

brands.title: Best CRAFTSMAN Tools (2026): Our Top Pick in Every Category
brands.subtitle: Sticking with CRAFTSMAN? Here's the highest-ranked CRAFTSMAN in each of our top-10 lists, from V20 cordless kits to hand tools and tool boxes.
brands.intro: CRAFTSMAN covers more of our lists than almost any other brand: V20 cordless tools, corded power tools, hand tools, and storage. If you're already on V20 batteries, or you just like one brand across the garage, this page shows the best CRAFTSMAN in each category. Every pick is the top-scoring CRAFTSMAN product in one of our ranked lists, scored on the same data as everything else on the site: Amazon star rating, number of reviews, and the features that matter for the job.

faq.q: Is CRAFTSMAN V20 the same as 20V MAX?
faq.a: Yes. V20 is CRAFTSMAN's name for its 20V MAX battery line, and some listings use both names. Like other "20V MAX" tools, it runs at a nominal 18V under load.

faq.q: Do CRAFTSMAN V20 batteries fit DEWALT tools?
faq.a: Not officially. CRAFTSMAN and DEWALT are owned by the same company, but their batteries are designed for their own tools. Plan on staying within one platform.
RP marks CRAFTSMAN's brushless V20 tools, its higher-performance range. They use the same V20 batteries as the standard tools.

faq.q: Should I buy a bare tool or a kit?
faq.a: If you already own V20 batteries and a charger, buy the bare tool ("tool only"). It's the same tool for less. If this is your first V20 tool, buy a kit so a battery and charger come in the box.

faq.q: Why isn't CRAFTSMAN the top pick in more categories?
faq.a: CRAFTSMAN makes our top-10 lists often, but in most categories another brand scores higher on ratings, review volume, or features. Each card says who ranked higher and by how much, so you can decide whether staying with CRAFTSMAN is worth it.

brands.title: Best Makita Tools (2026): Our Top Pick in Every Category
brands.subtitle: Loyal to Makita teal? Here's the highest-ranked Makita in each of our top-10 lists, from 18V LXT cordless tools to corded grinders and sanders.
brands.intro: Makita owners usually stay on the 18V LXT battery platform, and Makita's corded tools have a strong reputation of their own. This page shows the best Makita in each of our ranked lists, whether it runs on LXT batteries or plugs into the wall. Every pick is scored on the same data as everything else on the site: Amazon star rating, number of reviews, and the features that matter for the job.

faq.q: Do Makita 18V LXT, 40V XGT and 12V CXT batteries interchange?
faq.a: No. They're three separate platforms, and each battery fits only its own line of tools. 18V LXT is Makita's largest platform, and it's the one every Makita cordless tool on this page uses.

faq.q: What does the "Z" at the end of a Makita model number mean?
faq.a: It means tool only: no battery or charger in the box. For example, XAG04Z is the bare angle grinder. That's the cheaper way to buy if you already own LXT batteries.

faq.q: Why is there no Makita drill or impact driver on this page?
faq.a: Our lists are built from Amazon's best-selling, most-reviewed products, and no Makita drill or impact driver made those top 10s when we last checked. See our cordless drill and impact driver lists for the best from any brand.

faq.q: Why are so many of these Makita tools corded?
faq.a: Because that's where Makita scores best in our data. Its corded angle grinder, random orbit sander, and jigsaw rank near the top of their lists, and corded tools don't tie you to any battery platform.
